contour_rule: Every proposal remains one complete rectangle in the source-local axes. Original and T01 circle occupancy plus the 0.02002 mm construction gap is protected; neighboring copper may limit either growth axis, but must never carve, recess, notch, or round a rectangular contour.
eligibility: Standalone filled F.Cu source polygon with exact supported geometry, four unique vertices, adjacent perpendicular edges, and equal opposing sides. The complete 1.25x per-axis growth envelope must fit inside the registered crop; otherwise preserve the whole source shape unchanged. Retain exact source spans and do not infer pad or net identity.

embedded_covered_circle_pass.rule: Within T02, recognize single-source-primitive exact coverage excluding aliases; each covered source circle is treated as individually round, center fixed, and promoted to its largest admitted shared diameter class fully covered by the same parent final geometry and inside the crop. No combining parent unions to infer coverage. Preserve source core exactly. No exposed copper delta from contained growth; show latent contours explicitly.

factor_basis: Owner-directed hard 1.25x ceiling on each source-local axis; not a manufacturing sizing rule.
limitations: Uses the existing native parser and Shapely; source contact connectivity is not electrical net intent.
Original sub-minimum source gaps cannot be repaired by additive rectangle growth and remain explicit open issues for the future trace task.
Corner attachment interactions are recorded without a claim that their severity is accepted.
Full manufacturing/electrical/native export/EDIT equivalence acceptance is outside this T02 experiment.
physical_component_rule: Preserve whole-board original F.Cu source contact partition including zero-area point contacts. All original contributions remain unchanged and each addition stays attached to its parent source. Audit all additions against every original component and other additions. Source contact components are not electrical nets or T01 envelope groups. Preserve original local source-contact adjacencies too: no new rectangle-to-trace contact pair, even within an already connected physical component.
protected: all ORG F.Cu source contributions other than separately classified traces
the complete accepted T01 scene and its round priorities
accepted T01 square-recess or negative geometry when explicitly represented; otherwise its accepted neighborhood remains no-write protected
purpose: Owner-corrected T02: finite-width copper-surface side-gap priority, corner-only OPEN trace issues, preserved physical source components and source contacts, fixed rectangle centers and caps, and embedded covered-circle growth.
scene_update: Source-center Y,X,ID order. Whole-board ORG contact-component labels are frozen before growth. Side-copper reservations and all foreign-component source copper constrain every rectangle; no new component connection is permitted. Covered support within the target core is redundant and does not obstruct its parent. All other protected copper and earlier T02 changes constrain each proposal.

trace_interactions.corner_rule: Corner/endpoint interactions may approach the hard spacing floor and remain OPEN for future trace review, but cannot create copper contact or change original component membership or source-contact pairs. Use a 0.00010 mm topology-only separation guard, independent of the side-by-side spacing target. Existing source attachment overlap is distinguished as a pre-existing port and recorded OPEN. Preserve rectangle centers and complete rectangular contours. No corner allowance may weaken a side-by-side copper-surface minimum.
trace_interactions.deferred_record: Record all positive-area existing-attachment overlaps, all corner near-gaps below the 0.02000 mm floor, all baseline side gaps below the floor, and all side-gap shortfalls with source IDs/spans, hashes, actual copper-surface distances, component labels, issue type, and OPEN_FUTURE_TRACE_SESSION disposition. Do not choose or apply trace repair.
trace_interactions.future_trace_scope: A later trace task may review recorded corner overlaps/near-gaps, source attachment extensions, and baseline or growth-induced below-minimum side gaps. It must preserve or increase each affected route width from its ORG value; T02 makes no trace edits.
trace_interactions.minimum_gap_comparison: The 0.00001 mm geometry comparison tolerance is for numerical equivalence/reporting only. It does not waive the 0.02000 mm hard copper-surface floor or promote a smaller measured gap to PASS.
trace_interactions.side_by_side_rule: Every side-by-side segment, local arc section, endpoint, and oblique side approach constrains rectangle copper to remain at least 0.02002 mm from the actual finite-width trace copper surface. The 0.02000 mm hard copper-surface floor is never waived by comparison tolerance. This side rule outranks any corner allowance. Keep native trace geometry and width unchanged in T02; a later trace task must preserve or increase ORG width.
trace_interactions.source_attachment_port: A pre-existing source contact is a port, not a side gap. Exempt only trace copper within a buffer of native trace width plus the construction gap around its exact original overlap with the source rectangle. The rest of the trace, including side-facing sections of the same arc, is still constrained. This preserves original contact geometry without inventing net intent.
trace_interactions.surface_gap_diagnostics: Measure only actual copper-surface spacing for side-by-side interactions. Preserve original gaps already below 0.02000 mm as OPEN, and require every new T02 side-constrained addition to meet the 0.02002 mm construction target.
